taproom.name: Abandoned Brewery Taproom
taproom.description: Dusty oak barrels line the walls. A newly broken stone staircase leads down into the dark cellar.

cellar.name: Fermentation Cellar
cellar.description: Cold air rises from cracked stone tiles. Strange glowing slime coats the old copper vats.

vault.name: Ancient Cask Vault
vault.description: A massive iron door stands open. Something heavy breathes in the shadows.
